title: User API errors during morning peak
executive_summary: User-service release 7.2.0 (deployed 07:56Z, switching the ORM to a batch loader) is the most likely cause of the INC-009 user API errors. user-service 5xx-level error rate rose from ~0.4% to ~12.5% (peak 26%) starting 07:57Z, and api-gateway error rate rose from ~0.5% to ~4.3% (peak 8.7%) with the same onset. Every ERROR log in the window is a NullPointerException in ProfileBatchLoader.load on v7.2.0. Latency, DB connection utilisation, CPU and timeouts were flat, so this is an application-level failure, not saturation.

corrective_actions: Roll back user-service from 7.2.0 to 7.1.3 (dep-c02e51b7), then confirm error rates return to baseline
Fix the null handling in ProfileBatchLoader.load and re-release after staging validation
preventive_actions: Add contract/integration tests covering batch loader null and missing-profile cases before release
Use canary or progressive rollout with automatic rollback on error-rate increase

Track ProfileBatchLoader NPE count per version

conclusion: The evidence points most strongly to the user-service 7.2.0 deployment (ProfileBatchLoader NPEs starting 07:57Z, one minute after the deploy) as the cause of the user API 5xx errors propagating through api-gateway. Status is PROBABLE rather than confirmed because the log query was partial and no rollback test has been run. Postgres slow reports and traffic changes are not supported by the metrics.
